title: Ancient Soldier Gear

{{Hatnote|Not to be confused with [[Ancient Weapon]]s.}} {{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Ancient Short Sword Icon.png |caption= An [[Ancient Short Sword]] |pronunciation= |plural= |game= BotW |other= SSBU |cost= |value= |location= [[Akkala Ancient Tech Lab]] |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Extra damage against [[Guardian]]s * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= {{List| * [[Ancient Set]] * [[Guardian Gear]] }} |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Ancient Soldier Gear|Ancient Soldier Gear|Series, BotW, SSBU}} is a recurring set of [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|And on that note... Sorry for the long preamble, but I'd like to provide you with some {{Color BotW|Red|ancient soldier gear}}.|Robbie|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Ancient Soldier Gear was created as a result of extensive research done by [[Robbie]] into the [[Ancient Technology]] of the [[Sheikah]]. It is distinguished by glowing blue features that vanish when the [[Weapon]]s are stored and appear when they are drawn, which possess much higher cutting and piercing power than metal blades.{{Cite|{{Big|Ancient Short Sword}}
The blade of this sword was made using an ancient power lost to this modern age. Its blade appears only when drawn, and its cutting power surpasses metal swords.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Ancient Bladesaw}}
This two-handed sword was forged using ancient Sheikah technology. Its unique rotating blades give it impressive cutting power that will slice enemies to shreds.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Ancient Spear}}
This spear is the result of countless hours of research into the ancient technology used by Guardians. The glowing spearhead has high piercing potential.|Inventory|BotW}} This composition leads them to deal extra damage when they are used against [[Guardian]]s. Ancient Soldier Gear is produced at the [[Akkala Ancient Tech Lab]] by the [[Ancient Oven]], which is a modified [[Guidance Stone]] created by Robbie for this purpose.{{Cite|[Cherry?] {{Color BotW|Blue|Cherry}}... that is, the ancient oven... is a machine I made to create ancient soldier gear.|Robbie|BotW}} However, this function is not accessible at first due to the [[Furnace]] outside the Lab becoming extinguished, requiring it to be lit again with the [[Blue Flame]].{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Cherry}}... erm, the ancient oven... creates ancient soldier gear. But I fear she's out of sorts at the moment. Hm. I'm afraid someone will have to bring the {{Color BotW|Blue|blue flame}} from the {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient furnace}} again...|Robbie|BotW}}{{Cite|Ah... The ancient oven... You see, it's a bit out of sorts right now, so it's impossible to make {{Color BotW|Red|ancient soldier gear}}. Hm... Yes, I suppose we'll have to carry the {{Color BotW|Blue|blue flame}} over from the {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient furnace}} again.|Robbie|BotW}} Once this is done, [[Rupee]]s and [[Ancient Material]]s can be exchanged with the Ancient Oven for Weapons, [[Bow]]s, and [[Shield]]s, in addition to parts of the [[Ancient Set]] of [[Armor]].{{Cite|In addition to {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient arrows}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|Cherry}} can make all kinds of ancient soldier gear. If you're looking to acquire some, give your {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient materials}}... {{Small|and rupees...}} to {{Color BotW|Blue|Cherry}}.|Robbie|BotW}} Ancient Soldier Gear is made out of non-metallic Ancient Technology. This means that that do not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], nor can they attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]].
